parts.part: Text fields, a multi-line field, a select, a consent checkbox

leaves.what: Bound every field with the react-hook-form adapter (FormTextField, FormSelect, FormCheckbox) and each field's own `rules`; no schema library.
leaves.why: Adapter's comment: "Validation is a resolver's (`zodResolver(schema)` above) or, with no schema library, each field's own `rules`, react-hook-form's".

leaves.what: Passed `validationBehavior="aria"` with `isRequired` on every field, the select and the checkbox, and `noValidate` on the form, so the browser does not stop the submit before the form's rules run.
leaves.why: The adapter's Form* fields do not set it. ds-build names it only for a field bound by hand with Controller: "`validationBehavior="aria"` where the form decides what is valid: ... the browser's own validation does not stop the submit before the form has run." So it was added on each field. That the browser would otherwise pre-empt the rules is reasoned from that line, not observed.

leaves.what: Multi-line field is `FormTextField multiline maxLength={1000} showCharacterCount`.
leaves.why: TextField prop comments: "Render a `<textarea>` instead of an `<input>`." and "Show `n / maxLength` under the field. Needs `maxLength`."

leaves.what: Wrote "Every field is needed, except the company." above the form and labelled the one optional field "Company (optional)", instead of relying on the asterisk.
leaves.why: TextField draws a required asterisk on its label when `isRequired`; Select draws none (its Trigger renders the label alone), so a form of both marks some required fields and not others. Select has no way to show it short of putting "*" in the label string, which would be read aloud.

leaves.what: Wrote the retention note as a `Body` under the consent box and tied it to the box with `aria-describedby` (the Checkbox passes it through and joins its error id to it).
leaves.why: A Checkbox that stands alone takes `errorMessage` but no `supportingText`; only CheckboxGroup has one.

leaves.what: Read TextField, Select and Checkbox past their doc comments, and field-styles.ts.
leaves.why: To learn whether the required mark is drawn (TextField yes, Select no), whether a field fills its column (base is `flex flex-col`, so yes in a grid), how the Checkbox wraps itself when `errorMessage` is given, and whether Checkbox passes `aria-describedby`. None of this is in the doc comments.

leaves.what: Read the whole react-hook-form adapter, not only its header.
leaves.why: To learn what value FormSelect gives the form (the key, `null` while empty), that FormCheckbox always passes `errorMessage`, and that `setFocus` and `setError(..., { shouldFocus: true })` work through the hidden anchor.

leaves.what: The form's column, the two-column row for name and email from `sm`, the full-width submit button on a phone. No arbitrary value here.
`VisuallyHidden role="status"` says "Sending your message…" while the send runs.
leaves.why: ds-build's table of what comes straight from React Aria: "Text only a screen reader gets | `VisuallyHidden` | For a status, or a name with no visible text."

parts.notes: Not seen in a browser (none allowed here): the 400px layout, dark, keyboard order and the floating labels are from the code, not from looking. The fields stay editable while a send is running; what was submitted is what is sent. A long consent label wraps beside a box the kit centres vertically (`items-center`), not top-aligned: I left it. Empty-topic value is `null`; the server gets the topic's id.

leaves.what: A receipt composed by hand in an outlined Card, which replaces the form: a check mark, a heading that takes the focus, where the answer will come, a `dl` of the reference, time, topic and the message as sent, and "Write another message". The `dl` uses an arbitrary grid template, `sm:grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)]`.
leaves.why: The kit has nothing for a confirmation. EmptyState is the nearest in shape but its doc says it is "What a list, a table or a page shows when it has nothing to show", its title is a plain string that cannot take a ref or `tabIndex`, and it has no place for the summary. Not bent.

leaves.what: `classNames={{ content: "gap-6 p-6" }}` on Card for the receipt's spacing.
leaves.why: Card doc: "To lay them out another way or to run them to the card's edges, say so on that part: `classNames={{ content: "p-0" }}`".

leaves.what: The heading gets `ref`, `tabIndex={-1}` and `focusRing({ className: "rounded-shape-extra-small" })`, and is focused in an effect when the receipt mounts; on "Write another message" the focus goes to the topic select with `form.setFocus("topic")`.
leaves.why: ds-build: "The ring is `focusRing` from `<kit>/utils.ts`; extend it, do not invent another." Adapter: "`form.setFocus(name)` reaches a field: each `Form*` renders a hidden marker before its control for that." Passing `ref` and `tabIndex` to Headline rests on Typography's comment: "these primitives are prop-forwarding targets".

leaves.what: Read Typography.tsx past the doc comment.
leaves.why: To learn that a type primitive forwards `ref` and the element's own attributes (`tabIndex`, `id`); the doc comment speaks of `component`, `size` and `colorRole` only.
ds-build: "`font-mono` is the project's mono face ... write it where the project wants one (an identifier, a time, an amount)."

parts.notes: The receipt stays until "Write another message"; that keeps name, email and company and clears topic, message and consent. Focus moves are untested in a browser. A programmatic focus on the heading may or may not draw the ring, depending on the browser's `:focus-visible` rule for it.

leaves.what: An inline message with `role="alert"` on `bg-error-container text-on-error-container`, medium corner, an icon, a title, the server's reason and its status, placed just above the submit button, whose label becomes "Send again". It stays until the next send; the form and everything typed stay.
leaves.why: The kit has no inline alert or banner. Snackbar is the only message component, and its doc says "A brief message about a process the app performed ... that never interrupts", auto-dismissing after 5 s and clamped to two lines: wrong for a failure the person must act on, so it was not used.

leaves.what: `isLoading` on the submit Button during the send, and a ref guard in `onSubmit` against a second send by Enter in a field.
leaves.why: Button's `isLoading` comment: "a spinner takes the icon's place, and the button takes no press and is no longer a submit button until it is false again. It stays in the tab order ... guard `onSubmit` there."

leaves.what: A refusal of one field by the server (422) is put on that field with `form.setError(field, { type: "server", message }, { shouldFocus: true })`: the kit's field shows it as its error message and takes the focus.
leaves.why: Adapter: "maps the field state onto the control's React Aria props (`value`/`onChange`/`onBlur`, `isInvalid`, `errorMessage`)" and "A refused submit puts the focus in the first invalid field".

parts.notes: The mock server (src/lib/contact-server.ts) answers after 1.4 s and fails about one send in three at random (503). To reach it on purpose: an address at `fail.test` always gets the 503 banner; an address at `example.com` always gets a 422 on the email field. First draft had a second "Try again" submit button inside the banner; removed before the log because the banner unmounts when the retry starts and the focus would have fallen to the page. Not seen in a browser. A resubmit refused by the form's own rules clears the banner (second callback of handleSubmit).

general_leaves.what: The page's header is the `site-header-block` (src/components/SiteHeader.tsx), unedited, with two in-page links (#write, #reach) and no `actions`. Copied from kit-blocks/SiteHeader.tsx.
general_leaves.why: `npx shadcn@latest add @ds/site-header-block -y` was refused by this session's permission system, so the file was copied as the brief allows. Block comment: "The kit's `TopAppBar` is Material's: an app's bar ... A public page's header is a row of links to its sections and pages."

general_leaves.what: The page: a `max-w-5xl` grid, form column and a 20rem aside from `lg`, one column below; an "Other ways to reach us" filled Card with a list written by hand (icon, small title, body) and a `Link` to a mailto. The grid template is an arbitrary value, `lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem]`: no token for a column width.
Icons are lucide-react's (Send, CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Mail, Clock, MapPin).
general_leaves.why: ds-build: "Icons are any component taking `{ size, className }`. The kit ships no icon library."

general_leaves.what: Read Snackbar, EmptyState, Card and Button past their doc comments while choosing parts.
general_leaves.why: To decide whether Snackbar or EmptyState could serve the error and the sent state, and to find `isLoading` (documented on the prop type, not in Button's doc comment).

friction: No type error and no second attempt: the build was green at the first run, so there is no `guess`. What cost time: (1) Nothing in ds-build or the kit says what to use for a message that stays on the page (a server error, a success): there is Snackbar and EmptyState, and both docs had to be read to see that neither fits; one line in the skill ("an error the person must act on is written inline, on error-container, with role=alert; the kit has no banner") or a small Banner/InlineAlert would settle it. (2) The adapter does not set `validationBehavior="aria"`, and the skill mentions it only for a field bound by hand: with `isRequired` on a Form* field the browser's own bubble would, as I read the skill, pre-empt the form's rules unless one knows to add it (reasoned, not observed: I also put `noValidate` on the form and saw nothing run). The adapter's header should say so, or do it. (3) Required marking is uneven: TextField draws an asterisk, Select does not, Checkbox does not. (4) A lone Checkbox has `errorMessage` but no `supportingText`. (5) That the type primitives forward `ref` and `tabIndex` is only in the source. (6) The adapter is not in the barrel; its import path (`<kit>/adapters/react-hook-form`) is given in the brief but not in ds-build. (7) The shadcn add command for the block was refused here; kit-blocks/ covered it. Nothing was seen in a browser, so phone width, dark and keyboard behaviour are reasoned from the code and the kit's docs, not observed.
